title: Barvain Hussain
body:
Lab par hai alajal ki sada barvain Hussain a.s.
Aa muntazir hai karbobala Barvain Hussain a.s.
1) Tera Zahoor azmate Quran ki daleel
Gaibat teri daleel e Khuda Barvain Hussain a.s.
2)Is teer bakht daur ko kuch roshni milay
Rukh se zara naqaab utha Barvain Hussain a.s.
3) Rakhdi hai teri zaat main rab e jaleel ne
Gyara (11) Imamatoñ ki baqa Barvain Hussain a.s.
4)Mumkin banade aake tu namumkenaat ko
Paani pa janamaz bicha Barvain Hussain a.s.
5)Tera Zahoor ho tau padhe aake woh namaz
Isa bhi hai muntazir hai tera Barvain Hussain a.s.
6) Ghar ghar saja huwa hai joh Abbas a.s. ka Alam
Kaabe pe is Alam ko laga Barvain Hussain a.s.
7)Baugh e fidak ka aake laeeno se le hisab
Zahra s.a. ke Ghasibo'n ko mita Barvain Hussain a.s.
8) Le aake jald chadar e Zainab s.a. ka intaqaam
Kehti hai yeh Hadees e Qisa Barvain Hussain a.s.
9)Yeh Arzoo bhi "Noor Ali" ki dua bhi hai
Qadmo'n main tere aaye Qaza Bavain Hussain a.s.
